title: Arbitrary base change preserves finite locally free scheme morphisms
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a finite locally free morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-finite-locally-free], meaning finite, flat and locally of finite presentation. For every morphism $g:T\to S$ of schemes, the projection $X\times_ST\to T$ is finite locally free [def-pc-fibre-product]. Neither constant degree nor surjectivity of $f$ or $g$ is assumed.
